subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-14
html:
SE Ranking stayed authenticated for a 3rd straight session. Fresh full pull on the 24-term FOCUS cluster found no new keyword-driven opportunity — the connector matrix (7/7 live sources) and comparison hub (5/5 named competitors: Windsor, Supermetrics, AgencyAnalytics, Whatagraph, Funnel) are both fully built out against every term pulled so far, and every remaining gap (Meta Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Stripe, TikTok, LinkedIn MCP) is still gated on an overdue catalog.ts connector. So this session re-audited the site's structured data against the current live code instead, and found one real, previously unflagged bug: the connector-matrix pages were shipping an unresolvable schema reference.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
All 7 /connect/* pages (GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, YouTube, Google Business Profile + others)Fixed a broken JSON-LD reference: each page's WebPage.publisher pointed at {"@id": ".../#business"} — a fragment no page on the live site actually defines, so search engines and AI answer engines reading these pages' structured data in isolation would see an unresolved, effectively empty publisher. Replaced with a complete, self-contained Organization object (name + url), matching the pattern already working correctly on the blog.N/A — structured-data correctness fix on the pages that carry the site's core MCP-integration keyword targets (google analytics mcp, google ads mcp, search console mcp, etc.)askarlo.app/connect/google-analytics-mcp — view page source, check the publisher field inside the JSON-LD script tag

Rankings/backlinks (fresh pull): avg position still flat at 100 (0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked) every day this week — unchanged since kickoff. Backlinks holding at 3/2 referring domains, same as last pulse. catalog.ts re-checked: all 8 gated connectors remain coming_soon and overdue, none flipped live.

Next: Also found (but deliberately did not touch) a second, lower-priority schema item: src/lib/schema.ts holds a correctly-written Organization/pricing schema for ARLO that's never actually imported anywhere — the homepage uses a separate, thinner hand-authored version instead. Not broken, just dead code; flagged for a human call on whether to delete it or wire it in properly. Everything else that could move rankings or backlinks — off-page directory listings, GSC sitemap submission, the 8 overdue catalog.ts connectors — remains human-gated and unchanged.
